NURSE BOARD · NEXT STEPS

Ask in Korean.
Check against the source.

Available today

Browse nursing and healthcare jobs by location, experience and work arrangement. Save listings and track applications. We are improving the service with feedback from early nurse users.

Planned Claude API integration

We plan to turn Korean requests, such as “day shifts in Incheon for a nurse with two years of experience,” into search filters, and extract eligibility requirements and working hours from original listings. The public service does not currently use the Claude API.

What we will evaluate

We will compare extracted information with its source and flag missing details for verification. Before deciding where to use Claude, we will evaluate query interpretation, extraction accuracy, response time and cost per request with early users.

USE CASES

What you can do

Explore day-shift and non-shift roles

If you want to reduce night or rotating shifts, check the work arrangements stated in each listing to find possible roles.

Find roles that fit your nursing experience

Explore clinical nursing alongside occupational health and other roles that use nursing experience.

Keep interesting listings together

Save jobs found across different recruitment sites and track your applications in one place.

PRODUCT DETAILS

Features

01

Search by your criteria

Browse by location, experience, role and employment type. Day-shift and non-shift labels are based on information confirmed in the listing.

02

Distinguish new and viewed listings

Separate listings you have already viewed from newly discovered ones. The date the service found a listing may differ from its original publication date.

03

Check conditions against the source

Review eligibility and working conditions, then open the original recruitment listing. Conditions not stated in the source are flagged for verification.

04

Save listings and track applications

Save jobs and manage application progress. If you choose to link devices, you can access saved listings on your phone and computer.

WORKFLOW

How to use it

The basic steps to get started.

  1. 01

    Choose your criteria

    Select your preferred location, experience level, roles and employment type.

  2. 02

    Compare listings

    Review recommended and all available listings, then open the details to check the conditions you need.

  3. 03

    Verify the source and track your application

    Confirm exact conditions and deadlines on the recruitment site, then manage saved jobs and application stages.

Frequently asked questions

Can I use it now?+

Yes. Select Open Nurse Board to visit the public web service. You can browse listings on a phone or computer.

Who develops and operates it?+

Nodeoff develops and operates Nurse Board. Contact jin@nodeoff.kr with questions.

Can it tell me conditions missing from a listing?+

We do not confirm pay or working conditions that are not supported by the source. Check the original recruitment listing or ask the recruiter about missing details.
